observation.visible_scene: A close-up of a clear plastic bottle filled with a pink/red liquid that glows under red lighting, its surface covered in condensation droplets. The bottle is held at the lower left by a hand and rests above a dark tabletop. In the blurred background are metal-framed chairs, a seated person in gray trousers with hands in the lap, a draped blue garment, and a black backpack; a small purple cap-like object sits at the bottom-right edge from the middle of the clip onward.
visible_changes: The bottle slowly turns about its vertical axis: a dark label with white markings, absent at the start, first appears on the right side near frame 19 and then migrates toward the bottom-center by the last frame.
The bottle's neck intermittently enters and leaves the top edge of the frame, and the bottle shifts horizontally by a few tens of pixels, indicating small hand/camera motion rather than a fixed pose.
The internal liquid/shoulder line tilts slightly as the bottle is rotated/tilted.
Background elements (chair legs, table edge) shift slightly relative to the frame edges, showing minor camera movement alongside the bottle's own motion.
The seated person's hands move in the background (raised near the top in early frames, resting in the lap later).
A purple round object becomes visible at the bottom-right from frame 6 onward.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause and continuation of the rotation (grip changes before the segment or after the last frame are unseen).
Whether the bottle is being opened, poured, or merely turned.
The full camera framing and scene beyond these crop boundaries.
uncertain_details: Exact rotation direction and total angle of the bottle.
Whether apparent bottle translation is camera pan or hand movement (background parallax is weak).
Identity of the purple object at the bottom right.
